formal_statement: ¬∃ (x1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), x1.size ≤ (27 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x1.gates[x2]? = Option.some x3 → (x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x3.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x5 : ℕ) (x6 : ℕ), x3.inputs = [x5, x6] ∧ x5 ≠ x6 ∧ x5 < (14 : ℕ) + x2 ∧ x6 < (14 : ℕ) + x2) ∧ (∀ (x2 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x1.eval (List.ofFn x2) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x3 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (7 : ℕ)), (x3 = x4 ∨ x3 = x4 + (1 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) ∨ x3 = x4 + (3 : Fin (7 : ℕ))) ∧ x2 (Fin.castAdd (7 : ℕ) x3) = Bool.true ∧ x2 (Fin.natAdd (7 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true) ∧ ∃ (x2 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x1 x2).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ((14 : ℕ) + x2 = x1.output ∨ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (14 : ℕ) x1 x2 (x1.output - (14 : ℕ))) ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal (14 : ℕ) x1 x2 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ))) = Bool.true ∧ ∀ (x3 : Fin (2 : ℕ)), PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal (14 : ℕ) x1 (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x1 x2 x3) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ))) = Bool.false ∧ PEqualNP.CleanedNonEdge.wireVal (14 : ℕ) x1 (PEqualNP.TopForm.opnd x1 x2 x3) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ))) = Bool.false
plain_statement: Fano plane (line l holds points l, l+1, l+3 mod 7; inputs x_0..x_6 then y_0..y_6), F the incidence function. No circuit of at most 27 gates, each an AND or OR of two distinct earlier wires, computes F and has an AND gate (the output or in its cone) true with only x_0 and y_0 on whose two operands are false both with only x_0 on and with only y_0 on.
title: A step toward: Fano plane: no circuit of at most 27 AND/OR gates of fan-in two (distinct earlier wires) computes incidence and has a double re-read incidence
